Definition: from G4204; to act the harlot, i.e. (literally) indulge unlawful lust (of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry:--commit (fornication).
BiblicalUsage: Porneuo is the verb, to act the harlot, to commit fornication, and it runs through the same warnings. Paul tells the Corinthians not to commit fornication as Israel did in the wilderness, and John hears the same charge against churches that tolerate it. Revelation carries it furthest, where kings and peoples commit fornication with Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that unfaithfulness to God always starts by looking like pleasure and ends by looking like idolatry. The wilderness generation fell this way, and the churches are warned not to follow them.
